Hi Jasmine,

We are preparing the listing and co-sell packet for Acme Corp and before we promote the listing we need to collect the standard security/compliance artifacts. Can you please provide the following by July 7 so we can complete the seller intake?

- SOC 2 Type II: summary + date of assessment period (full report available under NDA)
- Penetration test attestation or letter (scope and date)
- Executed DPA or your preferred DPA template / redlines
- Data flow / architecture diagram (high level, include encryption at rest/in-transit)
- Contact for security/infra to answer follow-up questions

If any of the above are not available or there are gating processes on sharing, let me know ASAP so we can flag on the intake. Acme is targeting co-sell enablement in mid-July and we want to avoid delays.

Thanks,
